resources.string: Before you join the SAFAR community, please read and acknowledge:
Meet at a well-lit, public location for initial pickup
Negotiate a fair fuel/cost contribution before the trip
Verify the identity of the person you are traveling with
️ Never pay in advance via untrusted channels
Do not share personal information before you feel comfortable
